items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: there was a movie that came out called “The Benny Goodman Story” with Steve Allen and Donna Reed.

ctx.x: So what kind of music would you play for school dances?
Well around that time there was a movie that came out called “The Benny Goodman Story” with Steve Allen and Donna Reed. And we used to play the Benny Goodman

tunes, you know, and things like that. And we played in the theatre for the original opening of the movie, in Manhasset, Long Island, just a trio — piano, drums and clarinet. And then we’d still play the old style of jazz, but we wouldn’t play any rock & roll. We were kind of against that. We were rebelling against that.
